meta.title: Services — Forcelis consulting and advisory
meta.description: Diagnostic, consulting sessions, monthly advisory, projects, Monitoring and Managed Services. Contracted separately from any plan.

hero.title: Human judgment, separate from the platform.
hero.subtitle: Every service is contracted separately from any plan, and you don't need one to use Forcelis. The Forcelis team delivers them.

guide.title: What do you need?
guide.intro: Choose by what you want to solve, not by the name of the service.

items.need: A one-off answer about your company
Answers to specific questions about your indicators
Guidance for your decisions, month after month
A piece of work with defined deliverables
Tracking your indicators every month, with a quarterly review
Forcelis doing the analytical work for you, every month

diagnostico.name: Business Diagnostic
diagnostico.for: Businesses that want a one-off answer about where they stand.
diagnostico.problem: Knowing where the business stands, which findings matter and what to address first.
includes: Business Score and a six-section report
The Complete package adds operational analysis using trial balance or ledgers, inventory and sales by customer and product
limits: Requires 24 months of CFDI; with fewer, trend indicators are reported as unavailable.

sesion.name: Consulting session
sesion.for: Businesses or advisors with a specific question about their numbers.
sesion.problem: Interpreting indicators, answering financial questions or guiding a specific decision.
includes: Objective and agenda agreed before the session
Concrete recommendations on the agenda topics
limits: Does not include work after the session or written deliverables, unless agreed separately.

acompanamiento.name: Monthly advisory
acompanamiento.for: Management teams that want ongoing guidance for their decisions.
acompanamiento.problem: Interpreting results, reviewing indicators and guiding financial or operational decisions, month after month.
includes: Guidance to interpret results and review indicators
Review sessions with the Forcelis team
Support for financial or operational decisions
limits: Forcelis guides; your team does the work. If you want Forcelis to do it, there is Managed Services.
How many sessions a month, how long they last, which channels and which deliverables are set in writing in the proposal, before starting.

proyecto.name: Project consulting
proyecto.for: Businesses with a specific need that calls for work with defined deliverables.
proyecto.problem: Solving a specific profitability or cost question, with defined deliverables.
proyecto.pending: Other specialties — financial planning, supply chain, finance processes and automation — are pending validation. Ask us before counting on them.
includes: A proposal with scope, deliverables and timeline
The work described in that proposal
limits: The final price depends on the deliverables, the quality of the available data and the complexity.
It is work by the Forcelis team, not a platform feature.
proyecto.duration: Depends on scope; the timeline is agreed in the proposal

monitoreo.name: Monthly Monitoring
monitoreo.for: Businesses that want periodic tracking of their indicators, without ongoing guidance.
monitoreo.problem: Knowing every month how your indicators are moving, and reviewing the findings with the Forcelis team every quarter.
monitoreo.pending: The description and scope are under review so they do not duplicate what the subscription already includes. Before you sign up, we confirm in writing what it includes.
includes: A dashboard and a management report every month
limits: Only what is on this list is included. For month-to-month guidance there is advisory; for Forcelis to do the work, Managed Services.

gestionado.name: Managed Services
gestionado.for: Businesses that want to delegate recurring analytical or operational work.
gestionado.problem: Having Forcelis do the agreed analytical or operational work every month and deliver what was agreed.
includes: Recurring analytical or operational work, done by the Forcelis team
Scope, deliverables and capacity agreed in the contract
limits: Capacity is not unlimited: every proposal sets deliverables, frequency, work capacity, client responsibilities, response times and renewal terms.

monthly.title: Three monthly services, three different things
monthly.caption: Differences between the monthly services

monitoreo.what: Periodic tracking of your indicators; description pending approval
monitoreo.who: The Forcelis team does the tracking; the decisions are yours

acompanamiento.what: Guidance, review sessions and support to interpret results
acompanamiento.sessions: Number and length, per the proposal
acompanamiento.scope: Guidance, not execution. Limits and channels, per the proposal

gestionado.what: Recurring analytical or operational work and the agreed deliverables
gestionado.scope: Scope, deliverables and capacity, by contract

process.title: How to contract a service
process.intro: Sign-up is not online. A person reviews every request.

steps.title: You send the request
steps.body: From the service you are interested in. The form already says which one.

steps.title: We get back to you
steps.body: To understand what you need and confirm the service fits.

steps.title: You receive a proposal
steps.body: With scope and price. The service starts when you accept it.

tax: Prices in Mexican pesos, before VAT.

closing.title: Not sure which one you need?
closing.body: Tell us what you want to solve. We will say which service fits, or whether the platform is enough.
